page.overview:
Who is Janine Pavlara?

Janine Pavarla is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

She is 5'3" and plump, with large dark eyes and luxuriant black hair, which she wears pulled into a bun on the back of her neck.

Janine is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was born in and went to the White Tower in 978 NE. After spending eleven years as a novice and nine years as Accepted, she was raised to the Red Ajah in 998 NE. Since she is new to the shawl, she has not yet achieved the ageless look. It was for this reason that she, along with Beldeine Nyram and Marith Riven, was chosen to participate in Rand al'Thor's kidnapping.
